meta.name: muapi-social-media-video
meta.description: Brand-aware social media video creator. Reads brand-identity.md, ICP.md, and messaging.md to write a post/storyboard, craft an optimized Seedance 2.0 Director prompt, generate reference frames with the best available image model, and produce platform-ready video.

copy.tagline: 根据品牌文档自动生成社交媒体视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速制作符合品牌调性的社交媒体视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate social media videos from brand documents automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create on-brand social media videos

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取你的品牌文件，写出社交视频的文案和分镜，生成参考图，最后调用 Seedance 2.0 制作平台适配的视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作社交媒体视频，并提供了品牌身份、目标客户或信息传达文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个冷萃咖啡的 Instagram Reel，无人机视角，高级感。
say.note: Claude 会读取品牌文件并生成视频。

say.text: 为我们的新运动鞋写一个 TikTok 分镜，时长 15 秒。
用 i2v 模式生成一个产品展示视频，参考图用这张。
say.note: Claude 会调用脚本生成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads your brand files, writes social video copy and storyboard, generates reference images, and produces a platform-ready video using Seedance 2.0.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a social media video and provide brand identity, ICP, or messaging files.

say_en.text: Make an Instagram Reel for our cold brew coffee, drone shot, premium feel.
say_en.note: Claude reads brand files and generates video.

say_en.text: Write a TikTok storyboard for our new sneakers, 15 seconds.
Generate a product showcase video using i2v mode with this reference image.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script to produce video.
